description: Liste des maîtres d'ouvrage en assainissement collectif et des adhérents au SATESE et à l'observatoire départemental de l'assainissement is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Morbihan. In order to provide technical support to the project managers in charge of collective sanitation, the Morbihan County Council has a service providing all consulting, expertise and validation missions: SATESE (Technical Support Service for Water Purification and Monitoring). Coverage: Département du Morbihan. The portal shows the English title as "List of project managers in collective sanitation and members of the SATESE and the departmental sanitation observatory" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département du Morbihan. Its keywords include assainissement-collectif, maitrise-douvrage, morbihan, observatoire. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2019-06-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
